value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym Sundays 9:30-10:15, Sept 14-Oct 26, $124 (plus $25 membership) for walking-3.5 year olds with a parent - their site says. They also list Kinderfun, Saturdays 10:30-11:15, Sept 13-Oct 25, $145, for 3-5 year old drop-off. Registration opened July 22 and runs until classes fill.
